label: The version battery is behaviour-locked to its documented contract, not to numbers: legs family-present/plugin-discovered/plugin-load (v1) and plugin-active/skill-visible (v2), exit taxonomy 2/1/3/0, family decided by parsing --version output of $OPENCODE_BIN, which opencode and which opencode2; the script contains no version or count literals, so stale pins of 1.19.3/2.0.32/16/57 are structurally impossible in it.

The dual-version CI workflow pins opencode-ai@1.19.3 and @opencode/cli@2.0.32 in both the matrix jobs and the both-install job, installs them into separate prefixes, exports OPENCODE_BIN, and runs the battery per family (--json --out battery-<family>.json, artifacts uploaded always) and with --family=both; its pins equal the installed versions on disk (opencode-ai 1.19.3, @opencode/cli 2.0.32).

CI verdict: the dual-version battery PASSED on main after the 2026-10-19 merges — run 39309852507 (push, 2026-10-19T19:18:20Z, head 793b50cc, 'merge(system-spec-kit): bring the rebuilt trigger index into the CI fix') completed success with all three jobs green; the immediately preceding main run 39308825187 (19:11:04Z, 6d7f6b84) had failed all three jobs, so the regression window was ~7 minutes and closed by the CI-fix merge.

Resolves the carried-forward question on run 39308825187: --log-failed names the failing legs — v1 matrix job: plugin-discovered PASS at 'all 17 plugin files discovered' then plugin-load FAIL 'the import harness could not load every plugin' (exit 1); both job: v2 plugin-active FAIL 'the stable read shows missing or inactive plugins' with details system-skill-advisor.js: status failed and system-spec-gate.js: status failed, while skill-visible PASSED '57 skill entries visible' (59 entries, 57 visible). Whether the same leg fails locally for the same reason remains open — the local check would need a battery run against the local installs, outside this iteration's gh-read-only-plus-battery-source check surface.

Claim-versus-reality on 'smoke checks': the workflow contains no smoke dispatch steps — its only non-battery assertions are that opencode and opencode2 resolve to two different absolute paths and print exactly 1.19.3 and 'opencode v2.0.32'. The per-version dispatch smoke (scratch/proof/smoke.sh) is documented as an operator-approved phase-011 activity, and 008's CI claim is battery-only. Minor drift: the trigger list includes .skilled/bin/tests/opencode-config-shape.test.cjs but no job step runs that test.

Packet 082's proof rows are dated snapshots, not live counts: proof.md (dated 2026-10-19) records '16 of 16 plugin files' (v1) and '16 of 16 active, 57 skill entries visible' (v2), but .opencode/plugins now holds 17 top-level .js plugins and CI's own 19:12Z log already read 17 discovered files. The battery's stable-read-plus-all-active design absorbs this drift; only the prose snapshot is stale.
Workflow trigger list names .skilled/bin/tests/opencode-config-shape.test.cjs (pull_request and push filters) but no job executes it — the path filter claims CI coverage the jobs do not deliver.

direction: Battery or workflow hard-pins versions or counts that could go stale and mask drift
reason: Full read of the battery source (898 lines) shows family detection is dynamic from --version output and plugin-active requires a stable all-active read over the live plugin folder; the only literals are timeouts and attempt counts. Stale numbers exist only in dated prose snapshots (proof.md).
